articles.summary: The board of directors of GATX Corporation (NYSE: GATX) today declared a quarterly dividend of $0.66 per common share, payable Dec. 31, 2026, to shareholders of record on Dec. 15, 2026. This quarterly dividend is unchanged from the prior quarter. COMPANY DESCRIPTION At GATX Corporation (NYSE: GATX), we empower our customers to propel the world forward. GATX leases transportation assets including railcars, aircraft spare engines and tank containers to customers worldwide. Our mission is to provide innovative, unparalleled service that enables our customers to transport what matters safely and sustainably while championing the well-being of our employees and communities. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois since its founding in 1898, GATX has paid a quarterly dividend, uninterrupted, since 1919. articles.summary: Third-quarter diluted earnings per share increased to $2.92 from $2.25 in the prior-year period Company expects 2026 full-year earnings to modestly exceed the high end of its previously announced guidance range Rail North America fleet utilization increased to 98.4% at quarter end Demand for aircraft spare engines remains strong Investment volume was $171.7 million in the third quarter and totaled over $4.8 billion year to date GATX Corporation (NYSE: GATX) today reported 2026 third-quarter net income attributable to GATX of $105.2 million, or $2.92 per diluted share, compared to net income attributable to GATX of $82.2 million, or $2.25 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. Net income attributable to GATX for the first nine months of 2026 was $294.1 million, or $8.11 per diluted share, compared to $236.3 million, or $6.46 per diluted share, in the prior year period.
